name: frogger
description: A fast floor drill where you hop your feet out and in from a squat to a plank. It works your legs, core and heart at once.
instructions: Start in a deep squat with your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Hop your feet to the outside of your hands.
Stand up or jump up from the squat.
Repeat at a steady quick pace.
